Tooltip_morphine: Instantly restores health, kills all pain and clears the mind, but does not heal wounds. Highly addictive.
Tooltip_naloxone: An opioid antagonist. Eases addiction, but leaves you hungry and parched.
Tooltip_fentanyl: A potent synthetic opioid. Instantly restores health, soothes all wounds, kills all pain and clears the mind. Extremely addictive.
Tooltip_oxycontin: A mild opioid painkiller. Restores some health and takes the edge off. Somewhat addictive.
Tooltip_sufentanil: A potent patch applied to the right upper arm. While it lasts it steadily eases pain and withdrawal and keeps you calm, but the addiction quietly deepens. Lasts for days; peel it off to stop.
Tooltip_methamphetamine: A powerful central nervous system stimulant. Instantly wide awake, but it won't be long before the addiction swallows you whole.
Tooltip_tranexamicacid: An antifibrinolytic. Instantly stops bleeding from every part of the body. Side effect: moderate head pain.
Tooltip_sulfadimidine: A sulfonamide antibiotic. Clears the infection from all wounds, but does nothing against the zombie virus. Side effects: severe head pain and a moderate fever.
Tooltip_dexmedetomidine: A potent veterinary sedative. Instantly wipes away panic and stress, but leaves you noticeably drowsy. Side effect: severe head pain.
Tooltip_GrassBandage: A rough bandage made of grass. Heals much worse than an adhesive bandage and will almost certainly infect the wound.
